texts.facts: The petitioner, a partnership firm, dealing in edible oil and allied products, is situated in Vadakkekkad Grama panchayat in Thrissur District. The firm is conducted on the basis of Ext.P1 licence issued by the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India. The work in the establishment is done by their own skilled workers. When the functions of the firm was going on smoothly, the respondents 5 to 7 and their henchmen made illegal demands. In the meantime, petitioner's workers submitted applications for registration under Rule 26A as is seen from Exts.P6 to P8. 2. At the time of admission on 07-12-2017, this Court passed an interim order directing the police to ensure that there WP(C) 39388/2017 is no obstruction caused to the loading and unloading work carried on by the petitioner with its own workers.
